content:
If you want something managed with precision, give it to a working mom.

Kicking off a new week by looking back at last week’s sprint:

📺 4 television segments (balancing paid content alongside earned media pitched and secured through personal contacts)

📍 3 cities (San Antonio WOAI-TV, Memphis WREG News Channel 3 
and Little Rock KARK 4)

🤝🏾 2 Meetings with News Directors 

✈️ 1 morning turn-and-burn flight to Little Rock and back just in time for “Meet the Teacher” night last Thursday

✏️ Now it’s off to the races for a new school year (the first day of school was today)!

People often ask how communications leaders handle fast-paced operations and complex logistics. The truth? 

Working mothers are the ultimate strategic project managers. We don’t just manage calendars, we execute multi-city media hits, lead high-visibility brand moments, and navigate zero-margin timelines without missing what matters most at home.

Starting this new week feeling accomplished and ready for my next stops (Austin, Houston, Baton Rouge and Minneapolis over the next two weeks). Kudos to every parent balancing professional hustle with family milestones this back-to-school season! At Verizon, we get it!
